dataset.type: The project will generate numerical data (MD trajectories, energy tables, binding free-energy estimates), structural data (3D protein models, docking complexes), and textual data (analysis scripts, parameter files, README documentation), totalling approximately 10–15 TB over the project lifetime.

dmp.description: This project will generate computational simulation data including molecular dynamics trajectories, docking outputs, mini-binder design libraries, structural models, and analysis scripts. The estimated total data volume is 10–15 TB over 12 months. Data will be produced using GROMACS, HADDOCK, AlphaFold, RFdiffusion, and ProteinMPNN on HPC infrastructure. The primary targets are the cancer-associated receptors HER2, CXCR4, and TRAF6.
